title: The notification view shows only notifications the user may see
statement: The notification view MUST show only the notification the signed-in user may see, under the scope ruled for q-notification-list-scope.
why: An unscoped view leaks another organisation's notification.

acceptance.text: Given a notification outside the ruled scope, when the user requests its view directly, then it is refused.

falsifiedBy: A notification view reachable outside the ruled scope.

sources.quote: Should a user see only their own organisation's notifications?
